Your holdings: Almost everything is flagged "SELL" or "TRIM." Your leveraged ETFs like SOXL (-78.17%), MUU (-61.79%), and PLTU (-35.29%) are showing massive losses and are subject to decay, amplified by margin. CRWD (+25.52%) is your only profitable trim candidate.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your stops, especially for the leveraged ETFs. Monitor any further news on chip sector weakness.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk and protect capital, especially with your margin exposure and leveraged products.
plays: Trim CRWD: Consider taking some profit from CRWD (25.52% gain) given its "TRIM" status and the overall market uncertainty.
Review Leveraged Stops: Re-evaluate stops on SOXL, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, METU, SPAL. Their decay nature makes deep losses particularly painful.
No new buys today - hold and watch: The current market sentiment and your portfolio's state don't support new long positions.
